description: This shell script is a test suite designed to verify the handling of ambiguous references (branch or tag) during git checkout operations, including setting up ambiguous refs, executing checkouts, and verifying outputs and warnings.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files to set up test conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success in execution of a command sequence.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file's output, typically for warnings or messages.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites or flags for subsequent tests based on previous outcomes.
